headlines.title: 정부 "단일 레버리지 ETF 개인 별 총투자 액 20 %로 제한 "
headlines.summary: 단일종목 상품 집중이 변동성·매도 압력 키웠다고 진단 과다호가부담금 확대·시장별 레버리지 배율 조정 대외 악재에 수급 불안 겹쳐…24시간 모니터링 가동 29일 정부서울청사에서 열린 긴급 시장상황점검회의가 열려 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부장관(가운데)을 비롯한 참석자들이 사진 촬영을 하고 있다.

headlines.title: 더 폭락한 단일종목 레버리지 … 배수 조정하고 투자한도 제한
headlines.summary: 정부, 추가대책 마련 급물살 이틀연속 폭락장에 출시 후 60% 이상 급락 홍콩식 가변 레버리지 도입 법적 근거 마련 목표배율 일별 조정에 투자액 20%내 제한 금투업계는 ‘리밸런싱 거래’ 장중으로 분산 30일 오전 서울 중구 우리은행 딜링룸 전광판에 코스피 지수가 전 거래일보다 287.07포인트 상승한 5950.31포인트를 기록하고 있다.

headlines.title: 코인 과세 폐지 청원 국회 계류 중인데 …" 예정대로 간다 " 못 박은 정부
headlines.summary: 구윤철 경제부총리 "가상자산 과세, 예정대로 내년부터 추진" 업계·야당 반발…"과세 인프라 여전히 미흡, 위축된 시장 더 죽는다" 비트코인 ⓒAFP=뉴스1 (서울=뉴스1) 황지현 최재헌 기자 박현영 블록체인전문기자 = 정부가 가상자산 과세를 예정대로 내년부터 시행하겠다는 방침을 공식화하면서 야당과 업계를 중심으로 반발이 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: 보유·거래 ‘ 이중 증세 ’… 세제로 ‘ 집값 진압 ’
headlines.summary: ■ 당정, 부동산 세제 최종 협의 공시가격 30억 이상 과세 강화 장특공제 한도 10억으로 제한 구윤철 경제부총리가 30일 오전 국회 의원회관에서 열린 세제개편관련 비공개 당정협의회 참석을 위해 회의실로 들어서고 있다.

headlines.title: 보유세 오를 때마다 전월세 올랐다
headlines.summary: 2021년 종부세 늘자, 서울 월세 11%↑ 서울 아파트 월세 평균 160만원 육박 늘어난 세금 세입자 전가 재현 우려 당정, 하반기 세제개편안 조율 나서 서울 아파트 평균 월세가 160만원에 육박한 가운데 정부가 고가주택과 다주택자를 중심으로 보유세를 강화하는 방안을 검토하면서 임대차시장에 미칠 영향에도 관심이 쏠리고 있다.

headlines.title: 집주인 ‘ 증여 고민 ’ 매수자 ‘ 급매 대기 ’… 거래 잠겼다
headlines.summary: 서초구 30억 이상 아파트 “稅 강화” 발표 이후 거래 無 세금 얼마나 오를까 다음 달 초 초고가 주택 보유세 부담을 늘리는 세제개편안이 발표되는 가운데 28일 시민들이 서울 시내 아파트 단지를 내려다보고 있다.  뉴시스 초고가 주택 세 부담 강화를 골자로 한 부동산 세제개편안 발표를 앞두고 규제 공포가 극에 달하면서 강남 등 핵심지 시장이 급랭하고 있다.

headlines.title: 정부, 美금리동결에 " 국내 경제·금융시장 영향 면밀 점검 "
headlines.summary: 거시경제금융회의…재경 차관·한은 부총재 등 참석 이형일 1차관, 거시경제금융회의 주재 (서울=연합뉴스) 이형일 재정경제부 1차관이 30일 서울 중구 은행회관에서 '거시경제금융회의'를 주재, 발언하고 있다. 2026.7.30 [재정경제부 제공. 재판매 및 DB 금지] photo@yna.co.

headlines.title: 美 연준 금리 동결 … 정부 " 정책금리 불확실성 지속 "
headlines.summary: 이형일 1차관, 거시경제금융회의 개최 고물가·중동 불안에 금리 전망 불투명 국제유가·글로벌 자금 흐름 면밀 점검 [서울=뉴시스] 미국 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)는 29일(현지시간) 기준금리를 3.50∼3.75%로 동결했다. 올해 들어 다섯 번째 금리 동결로, 연준은 중동 분쟁에 따른 높은 불확실성에도 미국 경제가 견조한 성장세를 이어가고 있다고 평가했다.

headlines.title: 한미 금리차 1%P 유지됐지만 한은 금리 ‘연속 인상’ 가시권 [미 금리 ...

headlines.title: 반도체 훈풍 에 제조업 체감경기 ‘껑충’…4년1개월 만에 최고
headlines.summary: 한국은행 7월 기업경기조사 발표…제조업 CBSI 103.2로 2022년 6월 이후 최고치 반도체·조선·방산 등 전방 산업 호조 영향… 비제조업, 물류비 상승에 두 달 연속 하락 평택항에 컨테이너가 쌓여있는 모습. 연합뉴스 반도체를 비롯한 주력 산업의 호조가 이어지면서 제조업 체감경기가 4년 1개월 만에 가장 높은 수준을 기록했다.

headlines.title: 제조업 UP - 비제조업 DOWN … 더 벌어진 체감경기
headlines.summary: ■ 한국은행 7월 기업경기조사 제조업 지수 4년1개월來 최고 비제조업 0.2P 하락한 95.2 반도체 호황에 제조업 체감경기가 4년 1개월 만의 최고 수준으로 개선됐지만, 비제조업은 오히려 뒷걸음질 친 것으로 나타났다. 수출 호조에 따른 온기가 제조업 전반으로 퍼지고 있는 반면 비제조업 경기는 후퇴하면서 제조업·비제조업 간 격차도 커지는 양상이다.

headlines.title: 보리 생산량 증가율 47%, 25년 만에 최고 … 가격 상승 영향
headlines.summary: 보리 생산량 13만6천t…6년 만에 가장 높아 마늘·양파도 생산량 소폭 증가…데이터처 조사 보리 촬영 고동선 (세종=연합뉴스) 이대희 기자 = 올해 보리 생산량 증가율이 25년 만에 가장 가팔랐던 것으로 집계됐다. 파종 시기 가격 상승에 따라 농가의 재배 선호도가 높아진 영향으로 분석된다.

headlines.title: 보리 생산량 47% 급증 … 마늘·양파도 소폭 증가
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 2026년 보리·마늘·양파 생산량조사 결과 보리, 가격 상승에 재배면적 확대 양파, 기상 호조로 단위면적 생산량 늘어 연도별 보리, 마늘, 양파 생산량 추이. 국가데이터처 제공 올해 보리 생산량이 전년보다 47.3% 증가한 13만 6천톤으로 집계됐다. 지난해 보리 가격 상승으로 재배면적이 크게 늘어난 데 따른 것이다.

key_headlines.title: US Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady for Fifth Time Amid Policy Uncertainty
key_headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark interest rate at 3.50-3.75% on July 29, marking the fifth consecutive hold. Despite the decision, Fed Chair Kevin Powell's ambiguous remarks on future policy direction raised uncertainty about the Fed's monetary path.

key_headlines.title: South Korean Manufacturing Sentiment Hits 4-Year High on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Korea's July corporate sentiment survey showed manufacturing CBSI at 103.2, the highest since June 2022, driven by strong performance in semiconductors, shipbuilding, and defense sectors. This marks a significant recovery from the previous economic slowdown.

key_headlines.title: Government to Implement Dual Real Estate Tax Increases to Control Property Prices
key_headlines.summary: The ruling party and government finalized real estate tax reforms including strengthened taxation on properties appraised above 3 billion won and limiting capital gains tax exemptions to 1 billion won. These measures aim to suppress rising property prices through dual taxation on ownership and transactions.

key_headlines.title: Korean Battery Makers Return to Profitability on AI Data Center Demand Surge
key_headlines.summary: LG Energy Solution, Samsung SDI, and SK On all recorded second-quarter profits, their first since entering the electric vehicle demand chasm. Energy storage systems and AI data center batteries emerged as key growth drivers alongside recovering EV demand.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Leans Toward Rate Hikes as US Policy Uncertainty Grows
key_headlines.summary: Despite maintained US-Korea rate differential of 1 percentage point, the Bank of Korea signals accelerating rate hike momentum for August. Domestic inflation concerns, particularly core inflation trends, combined with moderate growth support the case for preemptive rate increases.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's manufacturing sector is experiencing a significant recovery with sentiment indices reaching their highest levels in over four years, driven primarily by strength in semiconductors, shipbuilding, and defense industries. The US Federal Reserve's fifth consecutive rate hold, while expected by markets, generated uncertainty due to Chair Powell's ambiguous forward guidance on monetary policy. This situation is particularly significant for Korean policymakers as they navigate domestic inflation concerns and capital flow volatility. The government is actively monitoring international oil prices and global funding flows given Middle East tensions and shifting US monetary policy expectations. Both domestic and international economic conditions are creating a complex environment requiring careful policy coordination.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The US economy is showing signs of deceleration with second-quarter GDP growth at 1.5% annualized, coupled with June PCE inflation rising 3.7% year-on-year, indicating sticky price pressures. The Federal Reserve's decision to hold rates steady while three committee members voted for a 0.25% increase signals internal disagreement and growing uncertainty about future policy direction. South Korea's Bank of Korea is positioned to accelerate rate hikes in August despite unchanged US-Korea rate differentials, driven by persistent domestic inflation concerns and core price momentum. Macroeconomic uncertainty from Middle East conflicts and ambiguous Fed guidance creates challenges for monetary policy coordination. The government has convened macro-financial coordination meetings to closely monitor these international developments and their domestic impact.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean equity markets experienced sharp declines following the peak reached in June, prompting securities firms to downwardly revise target prices for listed companies across the board. US Treasury yields surged significantly following the Fed's ambiguous guidance, disrupting global financial markets and pressuring Asian equities including Korea. Foreign investor outflows from Korean markets are intensifying as domestic stock volatility increases and international rate expectations shift. The Korean won strengthened by over 110 won against the dollar this month, marking the fifth-largest monthly appreciation on record, though analysts question whether this represents structural strength or temporary market dynamics. Bond markets globally experienced sharp declines as long-term interest rates rose dramatically in response to Fed policy uncertainty and inflation concerns.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's three major battery manufacturers achieved profitability simultaneously in the second quarter, emerging from the EV demand chasm through diversification into energy storage systems and AI data center batteries. The energy storage sector has become crucial for battery makers, with strong demand from North American and European markets offsetting slowing electric vehicle sales. Major Korean battery companies are targeting German automakers, with recent contract wins from Mercedes-Benz's new projects expanding their client base among German manufacturers. AI-driven demand for data center power solutions represents a new growth engine for the industry beyond traditional automotive applications. These developments suggest the Korean battery industry is successfully transitioning from its previous downturn through strategic market diversification.
sections.Real Estate: Lease-to-monthly rental conversions are accelerating in Seoul's non-apartment housing market, with monthly rental transactions now representing approximately 80% of all rental transactions due to strict lending regulations and land transaction restrictions. Jeonse (long-term deposit rental) prices have surged beyond 1 billion won even in outlying districts like Seongbuk, signaling a spread of housing affordability pressures from Seoul to provincial areas. Apartment subscription account membership has dropped below 26 million subscribers, with over 300,000 accounts cancelled so far this year as rising apartment prices and loan restrictions erode the viability of the subscription system. The government's housing fund has become increasingly strained by special lending programs and gap-jeon scam support measures, diverting resources from core housing policy objectives. Monthly rental stabilization remains a critical challenge as the traditional jeonse system deteriorates under current financial and regulatory conditions.
sections.International Economy: Uncertainty surrounding the Federal Reserve's monetary policy path, with half of the 18 FOMC members expecting rate increases this year, continues to constrain international investment sentiment and create market volatility. US-Korea trade tensions are intensifying, with American tariffs of 50% on Korean steel products limiting export competitiveness and forcing producers to establish local manufacturing facilities for market access. US-China economic representatives are under pressure to advance trade agreement implementation ahead of a September summit, though disputes over critical materials export controls and business sanctions continue escalating. Japan has initiated anti-dumping investigations into Korean rolled steel products, adding to Korean exporters' challenges in key markets. Global trade tensions involving tariffs, supply chain security, and critical material controls are creating a complex international economic environment affecting Korean exporters.
sections.AI & Economy: Amazon Web Services achieved its fastest quarterly growth in four years, with AWS AI-related cloud services and proprietary chip businesses each expected to exceed $25 billion in annualized revenue by 2028. Microsoft demonstrated AI revenue monetization through accelerating cloud growth, earning market approval and sharp stock price increases despite massive AI infrastructure investments. Meta faced market skepticism over excessive AI investment expansion, resulting in post-earnings stock declines amid concerns about spending sustainability and return on investment. Major Korean institutions like Korea Securities Computing and Korea Land Trust are implementing AI-based training programs to enhance workforce digital capabilities and operational efficiency. Nobel Prize-winning economist Peter Howitt warns that governments must establish safety nets and retraining programs to address AI-driven employment shocks, citing Denmark's flexicurity model as a viable solution.
sections.Others: Elon Musk is increasing political involvement with substantial campaign contributions to Republican causes through the America PAC, contradicting earlier statements about withdrawing from politics and potentially becoming a key driver of Trump's polling recovery. South Korean and Chilean business leaders agreed to expand economic cooperation beyond traditional resource trade to include critical minerals, advanced technology, digital innovation, and clean energy partnerships. The US Trump administration is considering collecting $100,000 fees from foreign students pursuing employment in America, potentially generating $41.9 billion in additional revenue while affecting American universities and companies relying on foreign graduate hiring. US-China economic cooperation discussions are progressing on rare earth export controls and Chinese purchases of American agricultural products and aircraft, though both sides continue economic retaliation through sanctions and export restrictions. International business expansion and geopolitical economic relationships are increasingly shaped by AI adoption, critical material access, and evolving trade dynamics.
